title: Guardrails hook (gh-account / pytest)
description: Config-driven PreToolUse(Bash) hook: block a mutating gh command under the wrong account; remind about pytest flags. Fails open, inert until configured.

hooks.name: guardrails
hooks.why: Optional guardrails. Blocks a mutating gh command run under the wrong account (per guardrails.config.json) and reminds about project pytest flags. Fails open; inert until the config is filled.

notes: Guardrails hook added. Edit .claude/guardrails.config.json (orgs + required account + pytest flags) to enable.
